alternate_official_notice_lane_note: Recovery notices can be published on a trusted status/help host, official social profile, or other already-modeled official channel while the primary route is under repair.
browser_warning_recovery_note: If a browser or Google safety warning affects a critical route, the office preserves a still-trusted official recovery/help lane and a current notice on an unaffected official channel.
delivery_role_note: Secure-transport review keeps current official voter-information pages reachable without certificate warnings, mixed-content breakage, or unsafe-page first contact, but it does not replace content correctness, ordinary help routing, or broader incident response.
hsts_and_certificate_posture_note: The office reviews certificate validity and strict-transport posture for official public-answer hosts and does not rely on users bypassing browser warnings.
http_redirect_entrypoint_note: Ordinary HTTP entry URLs redirect cleanly to their HTTPS equivalents for public entry routes rather than leaving parallel insecure shells alive.
https_only_boundary_note: Critical public-answer routes are intended to be served only over HTTPS and are treated as untrustworthy if a plain-HTTP path remains authoritative by accident.
mixed_content_zero_tolerance_note: Critical public-answer routes are reviewed for insecure subresources so blocked scripts, styles, maps, forms, or viewers do not hollow out an otherwise secure page.
mixed_download_boundary_note: Downloads initiated from critical public-answer pages avoid insecure transport so a secure-looking page does not hand voters an insecure file path.
no_clickthrough_bypass_note: Public recovery instructions do not tell users to click through certificate or unsafe-site browser warnings.
secure_transport_surface_label: Example State official voter-information secure-transport and browser-warning policy
security_issues_monitoring_note: Search Console Security Issues and equivalent public-warning checks are reviewed during major releases and when unexplained trust or traffic failures appear.
third_party_dependency_boundary_note: Load-bearing third-party scripts, embeds, and downloads on critical routes are known well enough to disable or replace them if they trigger warnings, deceptive behavior, or unsafe redirects.
